name: r032.fresh_camp_establishment_v001_mcw
description: R-032 fresh establishment route: a disposable current-source pre-camp world has one setup-only nearby unassigned follower, then the player follows only advertised native semantic dialogue and menu owners to establish a camp on the eligible site.  The independent run must retain the accepted conversation and camp-type receipts plus the resulting native camp identity; fixture setup and selector opening have no outcome credit.

steps.label: establish_r032_camp
steps.objective: Use only currently advertised native semantic actions to select the setup-only nearby follower, enter the native camp conversation, select an eligible offered camp type, and inspect the resulting camp identity and assigned actor state.
proof_targets: fixture-derived follower identity and no assigned camp, recorded as setup only
accepted native World, dialogue, and menu receipts for the chosen establishment route
resulting authoritative camp identity, owner, site, and actor assignment
independent native postcondition observation after establishment
invariants: fixture installation and its added follower are setup only and receive zero establishment credit
do not use physical controls, OCR, coordinates, source inference, direct NPC/camp/save mutation, or synthetic receipt injection
camp selector availability or selection alone does not prove establishment
a passing establishment verdict requires a same-run authoritative resulting camp identity and the actual assigned actor
leave missions, Food, Storage, Locker, and Patrol as separate R-032 verdicts
stop the affected claim at missing native receipt, source-binding drift, stale owner, or cleanup failure while retaining independent evidence
